title: Offer
description: Canonical offer schema v1.2. Represents a product being sold at a specific store at a specific price. The same product can have multiple offers from different stores. This is the core of the price comparison layer. Unicommerce is inventory-only — it updates existing offers, it does not create new ones.

id.description: Your internal unique offer ID. Generated by your system. Never comes from the platform.

x-source.unicommerce: not applicable — Unicommerce updates existing offers, does not create them

productId.description: Your internal canonical product ID from product.schema.json. Links the offer to the product. Must exist in the products collection.

x-source.shopify: look up by sourceId after product ingestion
x-source.magento: look up by sourceId after product ingestion
x-source.woocommerce: look up by sourceId after product ingestion
x-source.unicommerce: look up by skuCode match after product ingestion
x-source.bigcommerce: look up by sourceId after product ingestion

storeId.description: Your internal store ID from store.schema.json. Identifies which store is selling this product. Must exist in the stores collection.

variantId.description: Platform variant ID if this offer is for a specific variant. Null for single-variant products.

x-source.magento: use sku as variantId for simple products

sku.description: SKU of the specific variant this offer is for. Empty string → treat as null.

price.description: Current selling price. Always a number — parseFloat() Shopify and WooCommerce strings. Must be >= 0.

x-source.woocommerce: parseFloat(product.price) — check on_sale first: if true use sale_price, else regular_price
x-source.unicommerce: itemTypeDTO.basePrice — this is the listing/selling price

originalPrice.description: Price before discount (strikethrough price). Null if no discount is active. Must be >= 0.

x-source.shopify: parseFloat(variant.compareAtPrice) — null if compareAtPrice is null
x-source.magento: from separate /V1/products/special-price endpoint — null if no special price
x-source.woocommerce: parseFloat(product.regular_price) only if on_sale === true, else null
x-source.bigcommerce: variant.retail_price — null if same as price

discountPercent.description: DERIVED. Discount percentage calculated from price and originalPrice. Null if no discount or if data is malformed (e.g., originalPrice < price).
discountPercent.x-derivation: originalPrice && originalPrice > price ? Math.round(((originalPrice - price) / originalPrice) * 100) : null

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Always 3 uppercase letters. Never store symbols like ₹ or $.

x-source.magento: not in product response — use store's metaData.currency as fallback
x-source.woocommerce: not in product response — use store's metaData.currency as fallback
x-source.bigcommerce: from store currency settings — use store's metaData.currency

availability.description: Stock availability status string for UI display. WooCommerce maps directly. Others use threshold logic defined in store.syncConfig.availabilityThreshold. NEVER hardcode the threshold.

x-source.unicommerce: compute from (inventory - blockedInventory): see availability logic below

availability.x-availability-logic: stockQty === 0 → out_of_stock | stockQty > 0 && <= threshold → limited | stockQty > threshold → in_stock | threshold is store.syncConfig.availabilityThreshold (default 10)

isInStock.description: DERIVED. Fast-query boolean for MongoDB indexes. True if availability is 'in_stock' or 'limited'. Must perfectly mirror availability logic.

stockQty.description: Actual purchasable quantity available. Can be null if the store does not track inventory. Must be >= 0.

x-source.woocommerce: product.stock_quantity — null if manage_stock === false, fall back to stock_status
x-source.unicommerce: inventorySnapshot.inventory - inventorySnapshot.blockedInventory — IMPORTANT: blockedInventory is reserved for pending orders

blockedQty.description: Unicommerce only. Quantity reserved for pending orders — already sold but not yet shipped. NOT available for new orders. stockQty already accounts for this.

minimumSellingPrice.description: Unicommerce only. Minimum Selling Price (MSP) — the seller cannot list below this price. Business rule enforcement.

productUrl.description: Direct link to this product on the store's website. Construct from store domain + platform handle if not provided directly.

lastSyncedAt.description: When your system last updated this offer's price and stock. Always set by the transformer using new Date().toISOString().
